tenderSchedule.title: AMC of Audio and Visual AV Equipments
tenderSchedule.description: Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract of Audio and Visual (AV) Equipments at Shakthi Bhavan & Green Building, Bengaluru, for a period of three years.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Superintending Engineer S and K office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Superintending Engineer(S and K), KPCL, 4th floor, KPCL Green Building, No.3, Palace Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall furnish satisfactory contract completion certificate of corresponding to above order signed by the head of the department or competent authority and contract shall be completed before bid notification date.

Bidder shall have successfully executed at least one order for Annual Maintenance Contract of Audio and Visual/Video Conferencing equipments of value not less than Rs.18.88 lakh in a single order in State Govt./Central Govt./PSUs of State/Government Autonomous bodies during previous five financial years (i.e.2021-22 to 2025-26). Bidder shall furnish one single order copy with order value not less than Rs.18.88 lakh.

Bidder shall have an average annual turnover of Rs.37.76 lakh in any two financial years during the previous five financial years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26). Bidders shall furnish annual financial turnover certificate mentioning Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) duly signed by Chartered accountant in this regard.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder profile as specified in Annexure-3 of bid document.
Bidder should have local office at Bengaluru for service during the warranty period, Bidder shall submit the documentary evidence such as GST certificate.
Form of Bid as specified in Annexure-2 of bid document.
Notarized declaration on Rs.300/- stamp paper as specified in Annexure-1 of bid document.
OEM authorization letter from any three of the OEMs specified in Technical Specification indicated in Section -III of Annexure-4.
